title: Describing changes over time / Gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu malee 'get', 'become' fi 'turn' kan ta'an siif dubbifama. Afaan Oromoo keessatti 'dhaabbataa', 'kennu' kana maleesu. Afaan Ingilizii 'be' (ser/estar) hin qabnu; gara qorichaa kennuuf malee qorichaa dubbifama. Afaan Ingilizii guyyaa lamaa hojii ('have changed') fi guyyaa dura ('changed') qajeelfama, akkasumas afaan Oromoo keessatti guyyaa lamaa hojii fi guyyaa dura qajeelfama. Mana qorichaa 'ani beekaadha' jechuu 'I am more tired' hin taane; 'I have gotten more tired' jechuu dha.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu malee: 1) 'get' + ajjeefamo (kan arratti) gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) 'become' + ajjeefamo/macaafamo gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) 'turn' + kulooli fi ajjeefamo gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) 'grow' fi 'fall' gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) 'used to' gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'I used to live here'. 6) 'no longer' fi 'still' gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) Guyyaa lamaa hojii gaaffii dhaabbataa kennu: 'The town has changed a lot'. 'Be' (ser/estar) + ajjeefamo hin qabnu: 'ani beekaadha' jechuu 'I have gotten tired' dha.

title: Speculating and making deductions / Seensa bilisaa fi seensaa qabdu
bridge: Afaan Oromootti 'isaa deebii dubbatan' jechuu akkasumas 'isaa hojjatan' jechuuf seensaa qabdu. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, modaal 'must', 'might', 'could', 'can't' + fiilichi barbaachisaa. Tokko tokkoo 'must' seensa bilisaa amantii (dhabuu) qabduudha. 'Can't' seensaa amantii hin qabne; 'might', 'may' fi 'could' seensaa bilisaa qabdu. Haala malee: 'must not' seensaa hin qabne, afaan Ingilizii keessatti 'must not' mana qabduu akkasumas hin qabne.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti seensaa qabduuf, modaal haaraa barbaachisaa fiilichi wal qabyaa barbaaddaa. 'Must' (seensa bilisaa amantii qabduu), 'can't' (seensa bilisaa amantii hin qabne), 'might', 'may', 'could' (seensaa bilisaa qabduu, amantii hin qabne). Guyyaa dura turan, 'must have + fiilichi wal qabyaa', 'can't have + fiilichi wal qabyaa', 'might have + fiilichi wal qabyaa', barbaachisaa. Fakkeenya: shara + modaal + fiilichi wal qabyaa (guyyaa hojii) jechuu akkasumas modaal + have + fiilichi wal qabyaa (guyyaa dura turan). Fakkeenya: Afaan Oromootti, 'isaa deebii dubbatan' fi 'isaa hin hojjatan' miti, afaan Ingilizii keessatti 'must not be' hin jiru; 'can't be' barbaaddaa.

title: Discussing Advantages and Disadvantages / Faraa fi godhaa qabdu
bridge: Afan Oromootti 'faraa' fi 'godhaa' jedhanii hojii isaanii akkas jestuudha. Ingliffa gara 'advantages' fi 'disadvantages' jechuudhaan tokko tokko akkas jestuudha, akkasumas 'have' akkas jedhanii hojjetaa ta'u. 'Pros and cons' jedhamu ingliffa gara qaama kanarraa akkas jestuudha, kana malee Afaan Oromootti akkasii akkas jestuudha. 'Por un lado' jedhamu 'for one side' jechuu haasa'aa -- 'on the one hand' jechuu akkas jestuu dha.
rule:
B1 lammi faraa fi godhaa qabdu akkasii akkas jestuudha:
1. 'Faraa tokko (of) akkas jestuu dha...' / 'Godhaa tokko (of) akkas jestuu dha...' -- gara klaausuu fayyyii fi amantiisaanii wajjin haasaa.
2. 'Faraa haala/gerund haala akkas jestuu dha...' akkasii akkas jestuudha.
3. 'On the one hand... on the other hand...' akkasii akkas jestuudha.
4. 'However' akkasumas 'Nevertheless' akkasii akkas jestuudha.
5. 'Pros and cons' jedhamu akkasii akkas jestuudha: 'Let's weigh the pros and cons.'
'Advantage' jedhamu 'of' jedhamuu hin amanu garuu, 'It has many advantages' (hin 'advantages of' hin jedhu).

title: Narrating a story / Seenaa isheen galmeessi
bridge: Afaan Oromo, seenaa isheen galmeessu akkaan mana hidhaa fi qoosaa ta'e jedhanii malee, akkaan mana hidhaa ta'e jedhamu yeroo hinka ‘uun’ ‘qoodhee’ jedhaa ta’u godhatee malees. Afaan Ingiliffaa, ‘past simple’ akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi ‘past continuous’ akkaan mana qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a. Akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu ‘used to’ akkaan mana qoosaa ta’e jedhamu fi ‘would’ akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a. Akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu ‘past perfect’ (had + participio) akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
rule:
Seenaa isheen galmeessu akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a:
1. **Past Simple** (afirmativo: suj + verbo en pasado, p. ej. 'walked'; negativo: 'didn't + verbo'; interrogativo: 'Did + suj + verbo?'). Akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
2. **Past Continuous** (was/were + verbo -ing). Akkaan mana qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
3. **Past Perfect** (had + participio pasado). Akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
4. **'Used to'** (suj + used to + verbo base) akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
5. **'Would'** akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
Conectores temporales: 'first', 'then', 'after that', 'suddenly', 'finally', etc. Seenaa isheen galmeessu godhachuu danda’a.
Excepciones: verbos irregulares (go-went-gone, see-saw-seen). Akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu fi qoosaa ta’e jedhamu godhachuu danda’a.
Akkaan mana hidhaa ta’e jedhamu 'past perfect continuous' (more advanced) godhachuu danda’a.

title: Arguing a point of view / Fidhii sirrii qabdu
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, fidhii sirrii qabdu kan hin kennu, duwwaa ‘kana malee’ ammas ‘kana hin malee’ hin godhu. Afaan Ingilizii, duwwaan ‘I think that...’ ammas ‘In my opinion...’ hin barbaadu. Hegaadan, ‘should’ dubbii qajeelfama ammas haala dhaabbataa kennu godhaa. ‘I think that’ (dhugumaa) hin godhiin ‘Pienso que’ (dhugumaa) hin qabdiin; ‘I think that’ (dhugumaa) godhaa. ‘I am agree’ (dhugumaa) hin godhiin ‘I agree’ (dhugumaa) godhaa; ‘agree’ afaan Ingilizii keessatti verbi jiraachuu dhihaa.
rule:
Fidhii sirrii qabdu afaan Ingilizii B1 keessatti, haala malee godhaa:

1. **Fidhii sirrii qabdu:** 'I think (that)...', 'I believe (that)...', 'In my opinion...', 'From my point of view...'. Fakkeenya: 'I think that recycling is important.'
2. **Sababba qabu:** 'because', 'since', 'as'. Fakkeenya: 'I believe we should save water because it's essential for life.'
3. **Haala dhaabbataa qabu:** 'should' + verbi bakka (‘to’ hin jiru). Fakkeenya: 'People should use public transport more.'
4. **Filannoo/hinka filannoo:** 'I agree', 'I disagree', 'I agree with you', 'I don't agree'. Gaaffii: ‘agree’ verbi jiraachuu dhihaa; ‘be + agree’ hin godhiin. Fakkeenya: 'I agree with your idea.' (‘I am agree’ hin jiru).
5. **Hinka filannoo:** 'However', 'but', 'on the other hand'. Fakkeenya: 'Some people think that, but I disagree.'

Gaaffii: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti sirrii qabduu hin qabnu, ‘I agree’ (hin qabnu ‘Agree’). ‘Think’ ammas ‘believe’ ‘that’ (haala malee) ammas dubbii sirrii hin godhu. B1 keessatti, ‘that’ haala malee godhaa. Adjectives ‘be’ hin godhu (I am sure), verbi sirrii ‘be’ hin godhu.

title: Talking about your job and career / Duraa fi kareeratti himi
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, ‘dura’ kan ‘qabe’ hin kennan; ‘dura’ jedhanii hojii tokko tokko qaban hin dandeenyu, ‘qabe’ jedhanis hojii tokko tokko qaban danda’a. Afaan Ingiliziffi ‘work’ (hojii tokko tokko) fi ‘job’ (hojii tokko) qabanis akkas hin kennamne. ‘Work as’ (I work as a doctor) kana ‘be’ (I am a doctor) akkaataa afaan Oromootti ‘qabe’ jedhu hin dandeenyu; ‘work like’ (I work like a dog) jedhu akkasuma hin dandeenyu.
rule:
Afaan Ingiliziffi B1 raawwatan dura fi kareeratti himi:
- Present simple dura haasaa keessatti himi: ‘I work as a teacher’ kana ‘I am a teacher’. 
- ‘Work in’ + sektata kana baafata (I work in a hospital), ‘work for’ + sirna (I work for Microsoft), ‘work with’ + namoota kana miilaa (I work with children).
- Kareeratti himi ‘career’ fi ‘job’ jedha. Fakkeenya: ‘I'm looking for a new job’, ‘She has a successful career’. 
- Haasa’aa keenyaa kana baraa dhaabbataa ‘would like to’ + fiilichi infinitive (I'd like to change careers) kana ‘planning to’ (I'm planning to look for a new job).
- Adverb of frequency: ‘always’, ‘usually’, ‘often’, ‘sometimes’, ‘never’ akka hojii keessan himi.

title: Describing processes / Mirgiinyoota bu’u (haa ta’ee dhuma jiru)
bridge: Afaan Oromoo keessatti, haa ta’ee dhuma jiru barbaachisaa seenaa ‘se’ hin kennamne (fakkaacha, ‘se calienta el agua’) ykn ajajaa lamaa ta’e barbaachisaa. Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, seenaa ‘is/are + participio’ (fakkaacha, ‘the water is heated’) fi barbaacha godhataa ‘first’, ‘then’, ‘next’, ‘after that’, ‘finally’ barbaachisaa akkas hin jiru. Akkasumas, afaan Oromoo keessatti garagalchaa hin qabneeffachuu wajjin tokko akkamii afaan Ingiliffii keessatti garagalchaa qabaa ykn ‘you’ ykn ‘they’ barbaachisaa. Akkasumas, afaan Ingiliffii keessatti guyyaa seera qindeessuudhaan dhaabbataa: guyyaa tokko, seenaa, fi barbaacha godhataa seenaa ‘be’ hin ta’e guyyaa seeraa ta’e.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti mirgiinyoota bu’u barbaachisuuf, ajajaa lamaa ta’e (haa ta’ee dhuma jiru) fi seenaa ajajaa lamaa ta’e (present passive: am/is/are + past participle) barbaachisaa. Fakkaacha: ‘The coffee is ground.’ Barbaacha godhataa ‘first’, ‘then’, ‘next’, ‘after that’, ‘later’, ‘finally’ barbaachisaa. Seenaa ‘you’ barbaachisaa. Seenaa ajajaa lamaa ta’e: garagalchaa + seenaa ‘to be’ + ajajaa lamaa ta’e. Fakkaacha: ‘The water is always heated first.’

title: Expressing uncertainty and possibility / Gaaffii fi qorattoo malee keessatti hubadhu
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessatti, gaaffii fi qorattoo malee keessatti hubadhu ‘dha’ fi ‘dhaa’ jedhanii akkaan ibsuudha. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu, ‘might’ fi ‘could’ jedhanii akkaan ibsuudha, ‘maybe’ fi ‘perhaps’ jedhanii akkaan isaaniif adabbii akkasii hubadhu.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti gaaffii fi qorattoo malee keessatti hubadhu: 1) Akkaan ibsuu: ‘maybe’, ‘perhaps’, ‘probably’, ‘definitely’. 2) Akkaan ibsuu: ‘may’, ‘might’, ‘could’ qorattoo malee keessatti. 3) ‘Must’ akkaan ibsuu: ‘She must be at home’. 4) ‘Be likely to’ fi ‘be unlikely to’ akkaan ibsuu qorattoo malee keessatti.

title: Making formal requests / Gaaffii sirnaa fi qorannoo sirnaa dhibuu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, gaaffii sirnaa kennu haala dhaabbata ‘maan’ ‘dhugaa’ jechuudhaan qabannee jira. Afaan Ingilizii, gara qorannoo sirnaa dhibuuwwan, ‘Would you mind...?’ jedhanii gerund (dhugumaa) hin kennine turteeffadha. ‘Would you care...?’ jedhuu mana hidhaa ta’ee isaanii wajjin tokkoo ta’u malee, haala dhaabbachuu qabnu akkas hin qabne efata. Afaan Ingilizii sirnaa, ‘please’ guyyaa sirrii tokkoo yookin gara qabxii fiixaa keessatti dhaabbata, akkasumas gara qabalessu godhatee hin dhaabne efata.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii gaaffii sirnaa dhibuu (qaxxa B1), sirnaa haala ka’ee qaban: 1. **Would you + fiilichi baay’ee...?** – ‘Would you send me the report?’ (Manaa biraa keessanii ifadamu). Sirnaa dhibuu fi amantaa qaba. 2. **Could you + fiilichi baay’ee...?** – ‘Could you help me with this?’ (Manaa kan biraa hin kennan godhaa). ‘Would’ dura haala sirnaa dhibuu qabnu akkasumas amantaa qaba. 3. **Would you mind + gerund (-ing)?** – ‘Would you mind closing the window?’ (Manaa biraa keessanii qorannoo hin kennan godhaa). Sirnaa dhibuu fi amantaa qaba. ‘No, not at all’ jedhaa mana hin kennan godhu. 4. **I would like to + fiilichi baay’ee** – ‘I would like to request a refund.’ (Manaa biraa keessanii ifadamu). Gaaffii keessanii godhuu qabuu akkasumas amantaa qaba. 5. **Gaaffii sirnaa dhibuu ‘Would it be possible to...?’** – ‘Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?’ (Manaa biraa keessanii ifadamu). Sirnaa dhibuu fi amantaa qaba, mashiinee qorannoo keessatti argama.  ‘Please’ guyyaa sirrii tokkoo yookin gara qabxii fiixaa keessatti dhaabbata, akkasumas gara qabalessu godhatee hin dhaabne efata. Misola: ‘Could you help me, please?’ hinne ‘Please, could you help me?’ jedhu.
